fact: A SADCAS accreditation certificate dated 14 December 2025 describes the Malawi Bureau of Standards as established by the Malawi Bureau of Standards Act (Cap 51:02); it names no national standard on information technology or data.

The Malawi Bureau of Standards Act, No. 14 of 2012 (assented 12 July 2012, published 27 July 2012), establishes the Malawi Bureau of Standards as a body corporate with the object of preparing and issuing standards, under a Malawi Standards Board; the captured text names no standard on information technology or data.
ISO's member page says the Malawi Bureau of Standards is the national standards body responsible for preparing and publishing Malawi standards.
